Cadence: Every 15 minUnit: %
Related: 1-day VaR utilisation (≥95%)
Defined in Monitor 2.0 → open
Details
How it works

A shock starts in one book (copy cascade, LP rejects, or crypto liquidation backlog) and the same underlying moves the CFD and exchange books together. Contagion score rises when multiple domains alarm within a short window while company equity drawdown and VaR utilisation climb.

Participants
  • Risk Owner / Exec Risk Bridge
  • Credit Desk + Crypto Risk
  • Trading Infra (kill-switch / bridge)
  • AI Detection Lab (second opinion)
Impacts

Firm-wide PnL hit, simultaneous SLA breaches, possible symbol halt, and executive visibility if equity drawdown crosses 5%.

Details
How it works

Many retail accounts sit above 90% margin utilisation into a volatile session. Liquidation engines then fire in clusters; if those accounts also follow the same copy providers, the book moves as one position.

Participants
  • Credit & Client Risk analysts
  • Risk Owner (human gate on leverage)
  • Ops (account leverage freezes)
Impacts

Cascade stop-outs, company equity drawdown, LP reject pressure, and possible negative balances if marks lag.

One signal provider accumulates an outsized share of copier equity. When that provider turns, hundreds of followers hit margin and stop-out together, amplifying toxic flow against the house.

Correlated PnL swings, margin spikes, and reputational damage if followers are force-closed.
